results.title: Original E8 tree inorder with universal leaf/node equations
results.source: tests/benchmarks/extended.json probe11_tree_inorder (verbatim datatype, type, finite contract); scratch/next-tree/public-gate.json independent constructor equations and held-out observations; docs/proposals/new/5/leant2_expert_answers/sections/07_recursion.tex tree-fold composition
results.transcript:
:{
inductive ExtendedTree (A : Type) where
  | leaf : ExtendedTree A
  | node : ExtendedTree A → A → ExtendedTree A → ExtendedTree A
:}
:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let providers := (← liftCoreM Leant2.sessionConstants) ++ Leant2.curatedProviders
  if providers.contains `ExtendedTree.inorder then throwError "benchmark forbids synthesis provider ExtendedTree.inorder"
  if providers.contains `ExtendedTree.flatten then throwError "benchmark forbids synthesis provider ExtendedTree.flatten"
:}
:synth extended_candidate : ExtendedTree Nat → List Nat where extended_candidate .leaf = [] ∧ extended_candidate (.node (.node .leaf 1 .leaf) 2 (.node .leaf 3 .leaf)) = [1, 2, 3] ∧ extended_candidate (.node .leaf 4 (.node .leaf 5 .leaf)) = [4, 5]
:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  if (Leant2.resultBinding? (← getEnv) `it1).isSome then
    elabCommand (← `(example : ExtendedTree Nat → List Nat := it1))
    elabCommand (← `(example : it1 .leaf = [] := by rfl))
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ (l r : ExtendedTree Nat) (x : Nat), it1 (.node l x r) = it1 l ++ (x :: it1 r) := by intros; rfl))
    elabCommand (← `(#eval if decide (it1 (.node .leaf 0 .leaf) = [0] ∧ it1 (.node (.node (.node .leaf 9 .leaf) 0 .leaf) 2 (.node .leaf 9 .leaf)) = [9, 0, 2, 9] ∧ it1 (.node .leaf 0 (.node .leaf 3 (.node .leaf 0 .leaf))) = [0, 3, 0] ∧ it1 (.node (.node .leaf 2 .leaf) 1 (.node .leaf 0 .leaf)) = [2, 1, 0]) then "EXTENDED_REPLAY_OK" else "EXTENDED_REPLAY_FALSE"))
:}
:quit

results.title: Flatten leaf-labelled binary trees using both recursive results
results.source: New independent binary recursive datatype; one List.cons head at tips and one List.append head at forks, with renamed constructors and changed payload placement relative to E8
results.transcript:
:{
inductive CompositionLeafTree where
  | tip : Nat → CompositionLeafTree
  | fork : CompositionLeafTree → CompositionLeafTree → CompositionLeafTree
:}
:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let providers := (← liftCoreM Leant2.sessionConstants) ++ Leant2.curatedProviders
  if providers.contains `CompositionLeafTree.flatten then throwError "benchmark forbids synthesis provider CompositionLeafTree.flatten"
  if providers.contains `CompositionLeafTree.toList then throwError "benchmark forbids synthesis provider CompositionLeafTree.toList"
:}
:synth extended_candidate : CompositionLeafTree → List Nat where extended_candidate (.tip 4) = [4] ∧ extended_candidate (.fork (.tip 1) (.tip 2)) = [1, 2] ∧ extended_candidate (.fork (.fork (.tip 5) (.tip 0)) (.tip 5)) = [5, 0, 5]
:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  if (Leant2.resultBinding? (← getEnv) `it1).isSome then
    elabCommand (← `(example : CompositionLeafTree → List Nat := it1))
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ x : Nat, it1 (.tip x) = [x] := by intros; rfl))
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ l r : CompositionLeafTree, it1 (.fork l r) = it1 l ++ it1 r := by intros; rfl))
    elabCommand (← `(#eval if decide (it1 (.tip 0) = [0] ∧ it1 (.fork (.tip 9) (.tip 0)) = [9, 0] ∧ it1 (.fork (.tip 0) (.fork (.tip 8) (.fork (.tip 0) (.tip 8)))) = [0, 8, 0, 8] ∧ it1 (.fork (.fork (.tip 3) (.tip 1)) (.fork (.tip 3) (.tip 2))) = [3, 1, 3, 2] ∧ it1 (.fork (.fork (.fork (.tip 7) (.tip 0)) (.tip 2)) (.fork (.tip 0) (.tip 7))) = [7, 0, 2, 0, 7]) then "EXTENDED_REPLAY_OK" else "EXTENDED_REPLAY_FALSE"))
:}
:quit
